title: 公平分发饼干
summary: 把每袋饼干完整分给 k 个孩子，孩子的不公平程度为所得总数，求所有孩子最大所得数的最小可能值。
insight: 按袋大小降序回溯分配，尽早形成强剪枝。若当前最大值已不小于最优答案则停止；相同负载孩子等价，空孩子也只试一个。
pitfalls: 目标是最小化最大负载而非负载差

solutions.title: 降序回溯与对称剪枝
solutions.idea: 优先放大袋并跳过等价孩子状态。
steps: 递归处理第 index 袋；若 currentMax>=best 剪枝
对未出现过的 loads[i] 尝试放入，递归后撤销；原负载为零时尝试一次即停止

code.java: class Solution { int[] cookies,loads;int best;private void search(int index,int current){if(current>=best)return;if(index==cookies.length){best=current;return;}Set<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>();for(int i=0;i<loads.length;i++){if(!seen.add(loads[i]))continue;int before=loads[i];loads[i]+=cookies[index];search(index+1,Math.max(current,loads[i]));loads[i]=before;if(before==0)break;}}public int distributeCookies(int[] cookies,int k){Arrays.sort(cookies);this.cookies=new int[cookies.length];for(int i=0;i<cookies.length;i++)this.cookies[i]=cookies[cookies.length-1-i];loads=new int[k];best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;search(0,0);return best;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun distributeCookies(cookies:IntArray,k:Int):Int{val ordered=cookies.sortedArrayDescending();val loads=IntArray(k);var best=Int.MAX_VALUE;fun search(index:Int,current:Int){if(current>=best)return;if(index==ordered.size){best=current;return};val seen=HashSet<Int>();for(i in loads.indices){if(!seen.add(loads[i]))continue;val before=loads[i];loads[i]+=ordered[index];search(index+1,maxOf(current,loads[i]));loads[i]=before;if(before==0)break}};search(0,0);return best} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> cookies,loads;int best=INT_MAX;void search(int index,int current){if(current>=best)return;if(index==(int)cookies.size()){best=current;return;}unordered_set<int> seen;for(int i=0;i<(int)loads.size();++i){if(!seen.insert(loads[i]).second)continue;int before=loads[i];loads[i]+=cookies[index];search(index+1,max(current,loads[i]));loads[i]=before;if(before==0)break;}}public:int distributeCookies(vector<int>& values,int k){cookies=values;sort(cookies.rbegin(),cookies.rend());loads.assign(k,0);search(0,0);return best;} };
